paragraphs: R' Yaakov, son of Shmuel’s daughter.
Mentioned in Berakhot 25b; Bali said in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: כה: gives Berakhot 25b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. באלי is retained as Bali, including the initial bet rather than the older Ali. Bali reports Yaakov.
The maternal relationship is explicit: Yaakov is son of Shmuel’s daughter. No title is supplied for Shmuel; Yaakov’s abbreviated title remains R'.
